notes:
Friend mode, a separate space for showing friends. Upload with Only app (default) or Both (app + Friend mode). Both requires a photo-safety check. Existing posts remain Only app. Settings prepares the latest 30 eligible own posts as photos only. No names, captions, music, likes, comments, stories, unread dots or private screens. Review every photo before entry.

A fresh diary PIN or verified device check is needed to leave. Mode persists across restarts. App notifications are suppressed and existing notifications cleared; Android screenshot protection stays on throughout Friend mode. General appearance is available, but account, inbox, profiles, update details and private routes stay locked.

Selected photos themselves can identify someone. The app does not automatically prove them safe. This does not protect against external cameras, compromised devices, previously saved copies or Android notification history. Wait for Ready before handing over your phone. Same private update channel and signing identity; no uninstall needed.
